description: This file defines the 'Config' class within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, including nested classes for configuration management, JSON serialization, environment variables, and path substitution. It manages plugin configurations, paths, security, and network settings for the server.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class managing server settings, paths, plugins, and environment variables.

classes.name: Config::Substituter
classes.description: Handles variable substitution in configuration paths using delimiters.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig
classes.description: JSON serializable container for server configuration parameters, including environment, process, and plugin settings.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::Environment
classes.description: Represents environment variable key-value pairs with override option.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessSet
classes.description: Defines process-related configuration such as user, group, priority, and policy.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::InputConfig
classes.description: Input handler configuration including locator, type, and output enablement.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::Observables
classes.description: Paths for proxy stub and plugin configuration.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessContainerConfig
classes.description: Configuration for process containers, if enabled.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::HibernateConfig
classes.description: Hibernate server locator configuration, if enabled.

classes.name: Config::InputInfo
classes.description: Provides read-only access to input configuration details.

classes.name: Config::ProcessInfo
classes.description: Provides read-only access to process configuration details.

methods.name: Config::Substituter::Substituter
methods.description: Constructor initializing variable map for path substitution.

methods.name: Config::Substituter::Substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution in input strings based on delimiters.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::Environment::Environment
methods.description: Constructor for environment variable JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::Environment::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for environment JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessSet::ProcessSet
methods.description: Constructor for process set JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessSet::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for process set JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::InputConfig::InputConfig
methods.description: Constructor for input configuration JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::InputConfig::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for input configuration JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::Observables::Observables
methods.description: Constructor for observables paths JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessContainerConfig::ProcessContainerConfig
methods.description: Constructor for process container configuration JSON container.

methods.name: Config::JSONConfig::HibernateConfig::HibernateConfig
methods.description: Constructor for Hibernate server locator JSON container.

methods.name: Config::InputInfo::Set
methods.description: Sets input info based on JSONConfig::InputConfig.

methods.name: Config::ProcessInfo::Set
methods.description: Sets process info based on JSONConfig::ProcessSet.

methods.name: Config::UpdateBinder
methods.description: Updates network binding address and URL based on current configuration.
